name: Create an IP Access rule
description: Create an IP Access rule Creates a new IP Access rule for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules
Creates a new IP Access rule for an account. The rule will apply to all zones in the account. Note: To create an IP Access rule that applies to a single zone, refer to the [IP Access rules for a zone](#ip-access-rules-for-a-zone) endpoints.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete an IP Access rule
description: Delete an IP Access rule Deletes an existing IP Access rule defined at the account level. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules/{rule_id}

name: Get an IP Access rule
description: Get an IP Access rule Fetches the details of an IP Access rule defined at the account level. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules/{rule_id}

name: List IP Access rules
description: List IP Access rules Fetches IP Access rules of an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules
Fetches IP Access rules of an account. These rules apply to all the zones in the account. You can filter the results using several optional parameters.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: mode (query); configuration.target (query); configuration.value (query); notes (query); match (query); page (query); per_page (query); order (query); direction (query)

name: Update an IP Access rule
description: Update an IP Access rule Updates an IP Access rule defined at the account level. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules/{rule_id}
